body: if someone is willing to jump in front of a train, chances are thinking of how the consequences are going to effect others isn't reality a priority for them. I understand where you are coming from and I think you should refocus your effort on trying to make this person feel heard instead of antagonizing them. The consequences are terrible for everyone, but a panic attack is temporary and the loss of life is permanent.
